title: Ordinary affine extension and sections comparison with normalized unit
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, g:Spec B to Spec R an affine scheme morphism, and v:g_* Gamma_R ≅ Gamma_B restrictScalars(rho), with rho the canonical coordinate ring map and v the identity on sections [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. Write T_R,T_B for associated sheaf and P for the tensor pullback [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There is a natural isomorphism c:T_R Gamma_R extendScalars(rho) ≅ T_R P Gamma_B whose transpose at every R-module N is Gamma_R of the fixed tensor-pullback unit at T_R(N), followed by v. The complete unit equation is in lean.statement. No derived category, complex, boundedness or flatness hypothesis is used in the assertion.

source.place: Tag 01I9, affine pullback/associated-module formula, via the tilde adjunction; Mathlib CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Unique.lean, unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app

proof.text: Let br:T_R ⊣ Gamma_R and bb:T_B ⊣ Gamma_B be the tilde adjunctions. Their units are invertible because associated sheaf is fully faithful. Compose br with the fixed tensor pullback adjunction p and transport its right adjoint by v to obtain a1:T_R P ⊣ Gamma_B S. Compose extension/restriction e with bb to obtain a2:E T_B ⊣ Gamma_B S.

Use Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq to form theta:a2.left ≅ a1.left. Define c_N to be E of the inverse of br.unit_N, followed by bb.unit at E(N), followed by Gamma_B(theta_N). Whiskering these natural isomorphisms gives the natural isomorphism c. The equation unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app says eta_E(N) S(eta_B(E(N))) S Gamma_B(theta_N)=eta_R(N) Gamma_R(eta_P(T_R(N))) v. Naturality of eta_E for inverse eta_R(N) identifies the transpose of c_N with inverse eta_R(N) followed by this equation; cancel inverse eta_R(N) eta_R(N). This proves exactly the claimed unit equation.

theorem exists_affineExtensionSections_underived_model
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    (v : RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ≅
      affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g))
    (_hv : ∀ (N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
      (x : (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).obj N), (v.hom.app N) x = x) :
    ∃ c : (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⋙ affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ⋙
        ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (affineBaseRingMap g) ≅
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⋙ (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g)) ⋙
        affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)),
      ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} R,
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (affineBaseRingMap g)).unit.app
            ((affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).obj ((tilde.functor R).obj N)) ≫
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).map (c.hom.app N) =
        (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).map
            ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app
              ((tilde.functor R).obj N)) ≫
          v.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj ((tilde.functor R).obj N))
